first.rationale: Onboarding simplification directly addresses both the 4% completion decline and part of the 6% activation decline, with prior evidence of improved time-to-value and adoption. Promotional pricing is the strongest alternative given competitive pressure, but its effect on long-term customer quality and retention is unclear, so both records should be verified before committing.

final.rationale: Run a standard experiment shortening onboarding. The verified source directly matches the current completion and activation problems, showing completion +13%, time-to-value improved by 2.1 days, and 30-day retention +3%. Although promotional pricing addresses competitive pressure, its verified 12% retention decline and failure through first renewal conflict with the objective of sustainable long-term qualified revenue.
